title: Exam Officer
format: Actual application screen captures with fictional isolated demo records; no live authentication, native installation or reconnect sync verification
voice: User-selected English voice-02; not a verified Nigerian-English accent

scenes.label: School link & sign-in
scenes.narration: Open your school's branded link. Staff and parents use their registered phone and four-digit PIN. This recording uses fictional demo records and a local session, not live authentication.

scenes.label: Find and filter exam papers
scenes.narration: Open the menu and choose Exam Questions. Review the missing-paper tracker and filter by term, class or paper status. Check the submitted teacher paper before approving it.

scenes.label: Review → approve → A4 paper
scenes.narration: Open the submitted paper preview and check its questions. Close the preview, then approve the demo paper. The paper and confidential marking scheme have separate PDF and Word controls.

scenes.label: All-class broadsheets & reports
scenes.narration: Choose Results and Report Cards, then Class Broadsheet and Report Cards. Select the class and term. Open a learner report to inspect the actual fixed A four page before printing.

scenes.label: Install school app
scenes.narration: Open your school's link and choose Install school app. The real help dialog explains Safari and Chrome steps. A native installation is not being verified here.

scenes.label: Offline guidance & privacy
scenes.narration: Sign in online and open needed records before offline work. Attendance and score drafts can sync when reconnected; review conflicts. Payments, messages and new sign-ins need internet. This demo does not verify live sync. Keep marking schemes private and publish results only after the school review.

timingBasis: Detected paragraph-pause cuts, reviewed against expected text length; captions phrase-timed within each recorded scene.
